name: facebookresearch_motif/scripts/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_motif/scripts/main.py.run_rl_algorithm: run the RL algorithm with parsed arguments and optional W&B tracking via main entry point
facebookresearch_motif/scripts/main.py.parse_all_args: parse command line arguments including custom env episode length and LLM reward coefficient
facebookresearch_motif/scripts/main.py.add_extra_params: add custom CLI arguments like episode length and LLM reward to an argparse parser
facebookresearch_motif/scripts/main.py.init_wandb_tracking: initialize Weights and Biases tracking for the nethack_project when WANDB_API_KEY is set
facebookresearch_motif/scripts/main.py.register_nle_components: import and register NetHack Learning Environment tasks, encoders, and environments for RL training

facebookresearch_motif/scripts/train_rew.train_reward_model: train a reward model using binary cross entropy on trajectory preference pairs from a dataset
facebookresearch_motif/scripts/train_rew.validate_reward_model: validate the reward model on a validation set and log accuracy and loss metrics
facebookresearch_motif/scripts/train_rew.save_checkpoint: save the reward model checkpoint, optimizer state, and training metrics to disk
facebookresearch_motif/scripts/train_rew.get_all_messages: extract and sort all training messages from the dataset loader for RMS calculation
facebookresearch_motif/scripts/train_rew.get_rms: calculate the running mean and standard deviation of rewards across the training dataset

facebookresearch_motif/scripts/visualize.run_visualize_rl_agent: run the RL agent evaluation script to visualize trained policy behavior in the environment
facebookresearch_motif/scripts/visualize.run_enjoy_function: run the enjoy function to evaluate a trained actor-critic model with optional reward model
facebookresearch_motif/scripts/visualize.run_parse_all_args: run parse_all_args to parse command line arguments for RL agent visualization with sleep and render options
facebookresearch_motif/scripts/visualize.run_add_extra_params: run add_extra_params to add sleep and render CLI arguments to the argument parser
facebookresearch_motif/scripts/visualize.run_main_entry: run the main entry point to parse args and execute RL agent evaluation with rendering
